page_title: MAI 2-0 STU | Mainz v Stuttgart 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Stefan Bell (Mainz) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Tobias Stieler blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

90+2' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Robin Zentner makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
88' Bo Henriksen prepares a substitution. Anthony Caci is replaced by Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) coming on for Anthony Rouault.
86' 2 - 0 Goal! Anthony Caci (Mainz) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Armindo Sieb inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
82' The resulting corner from Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared by the defence.
81' Mainz earn a corner.
80' The ball goes out of play. Mainz are awarded a corner kick.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
76' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mainz comes to nothing.
74' Maxim Leitsch (Mainz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dominik Kohr.
74' Nelson Weiper comes off the pitch to be replaced by Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
72' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Atakan Karazor.
72' Here comes a substitution. Jacob Bruun Larsen is given a rest as he is replaced by Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart).
69' Mainz take a short corner kick.
68' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
65' None of the Mainz players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Danny da Costa leaves the pitch and Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) comes on.
62' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Chris Fuhrich.
62' Substitution. Maximilian Mittelstadt makes way for Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart).
60' A quickly taken corner by Mainz.
60' Paul Nebel (Mainz) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
57' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Stieler and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' Anthony Caci (Mainz) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
53' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
48' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
41' Robin Zentner (Mainz) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
41' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
36' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Nelson Weiper (Mainz) duly receives a yellow card.

29' 1 - 0 Paul Nebel is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Nelson Weiper (Mainz) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom left corner to make the score 1:0.
28' Stuttgart fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.

27' Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
27' Jacob Bruun Larsen (VfB Stuttgart) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
22' A corner kick by Mainz is thwarted by the well prepared Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart).
16' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Stieler had an easy-decision to make.
15' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Nick Woltemade and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
10' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
8' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
6' Wonderful movement by Stuttgart. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
4' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
4' Anthony Caci (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Mainz can continue in their attacking effort.
3' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
3' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Stuttgart will kick-off.
Tobias Stieler is introduced as the referee for today's match.
